LanguageData.MT_ModularTurrets.label: modular turrets
LanguageData.MT_ModularTurrets.description: Unlock replaceable turret bases, the assembly bench, basic main heads and support modules. The initial platform is intended for vanilla-scale defenses.
LanguageData.MT_AdvancedTurrets.label: advanced turret engineering
LanguageData.MT_AdvancedTurrets.description: Unlock dual heads, miniguns, shell-fed mortars, missile launchers, shield modules, tracking servos and precision fire controllers. Also unlock tier I-III upgrades for installed heads and modules.
LanguageData.MT_ExoticTurrets.label: exotic energy turrets
LanguageData.MT_ExoticTurrets.description: Unlock laser, Tesla and quantum heads, and tier IV-V upgrades for installed heads and modules. Quantum fire retains aiming and burst timing but applies immediate single-target damage without projectile travel or area damage.
LanguageData.MT_InfiniteEngineering.label: infinite turret engineering
LanguageData.MT_InfiniteEngineering.description: Unlock repeatable damage, protection and range improvements for the turret base. Now the baseplate matters too.
